user.title: MOCREO IoT Platform Setup
user.description: Log in with your MOCREO account credentials. The integration will automatically discover your assets and generate a secure API Key for Home Assistant.

select_asset.title: Select MOCREO Asset
select_asset.description: Select the MOCREO Asset (logical container/location) containing the devices you want to sync.
